snippet.title: Give Me 20 Minutes, I Will Make You a Claude Pro
snippet.description:
🚀 Join the Agentic Academy: https://skool.com/scrapes
👀 Be the brand AI recommends: https://dub.sh/rankspot-yt
Don't miss the next build - https://www.youtube.com/@simonscrapes?sub_confirmation=1
Free resources for this video: https://skool.com/scrapesai

The official rules for prompting Claude have changed. What worked last year might be hurting your performance today. In this video, I'll walk you through five copy-and-paste upgrades based directly on Anthropic's latest documentation. In just 20 minutes, you'll learn how to build better prompts, set goals, organize projects, create reusable skills, and build a lasting memory for Claude.

11:02 - 4: Build Skills How They Were Made to be Built

17:15 - How to Stack All 5 Upgrades
